column3: The reward is a separate statement: “your reward is very great.”
“A son of my house” is rendered as “a servant in my household.”
The Hebrew says “from your inward parts” where BSB has “from your own body.”
The Hebrew has an active verb, “he reckoned it to him,” rather than “it was credited.”
The Hebrew has “the bird” in the singular where BSB has “the birds.”
The Hebrew says a deep sleep “fell on Abram,” and introduces the terror with “behold.”
The Hebrew says “they will serve them” where BSB says “they will be enslaved.”
“Appeared” and “of the carcasses” are supplied in BSB.
